newsitem.title: USA: National Energy to buy Louisiana reserves.
newsitem.headline: National Energy to buy Louisiana reserves.

text.p: National Energy Group Inc said Monday it has signed letters of intent to purchase producing oil and gas properties estimated to contain about 2 million barrels of crude oil and 8 billion cubic feet of natural gas from two private oil and gas companies for about $9.8 million in cash and stock.
The properties are located in the South Lake Boeuf Field in Lafourche Parish, La., National Energy said.
It said the cash portion of the price will be $1.5 million and the purchase is expected to close around October 10.
The company said Netherland, Sewell & Associates Inc has estimated the present discounted value of the properties to be about $20 million. The reserves are found in ten different horizons.

"The South Lake Boeuf properties offer considerable potential for adding additional reserves, production and cash flow from several behind pipe zones and in development drilling of the proved undeveloped reserves.
"These properties are mostly crude oil and will go toward balancing the recent additions of natural gas."
